[[File:Fuliginous.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Fuliginous'' departs the Makeb orbital station]]
'''''Fuliginous''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by [[Darth Marr]], a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]], to travel in secret to the [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]] and meet with his agents there.
